title: Instagram Followers & Following Pro input
description: Export followers and following of Instagram profiles with your own session.

sessionCookie.title: Your Instagram session cookie
sessionCookie.description: Instagram only shows follower lists to logged-in accounts. Paste the "sessionid" cookie of instagram.com (or the whole cookie / a cookie-extension JSON export). Stored encrypted by Apify. Use a secondary account — see the README for how to get it and how to stay safe.

usernames.title: Instagram profiles
usernames.description: Usernames (natgeo, @natgeo) or profile URLs. A URL ending in /followers/ or /following/ scrapes just that list.

type.title: Lists to export
type.description: Each row says FOLLOWER or FOLLOWING in "type". With "Both", following is read first so followers get "isMutual".

maxResultsPerProfile.title: Max accounts per list
maxResultsPerProfile.description: Accounts to save per profile and list. Start small: big lists take long and every request uses your account. Filtered accounts do not count.

maxResults.title: Max accounts in total
maxResults.description: Stop after this many saved (and charged) accounts across all profiles. 0 = no limit.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich profiles (bio, counts, business contacts)
enrichProfiles.description: Open each account's profile to add bio, links, follower/following/post counts, business category, email, phone and address. One extra request per account — much slower, charged per enriched profile.

onlyVerified.title: Only verified accounts
onlyVerified.description: Keep only accounts with the blue badge.

excludeNoProfilePic.title: Leave out accounts without a profile picture
excludeNoProfilePic.description: Skip accounts showing the default grey avatar.

excludeLowQuality.title: Leave out low-quality accounts
excludeLowQuality.description: Skip accounts with 2+ low-quality signals (no picture, no name, digit-heavy username; with enrichment also no posts, no bio, follows far more than followers).

nameKeywords.title: Name / username contains
nameKeywords.description: Keep accounts whose username or full name contains any of these (any case).

bioKeywords.title: Bio contains (needs enrichment)
bioKeywords.description: Keep accounts whose bio or business category contains any of these. Turns on enrichment.

maxFollowers.title: Max followers (needs enrichment)
maxFollowers.description: Find micro-influencers, e.g. 50000. 0 = off. Turns on enrichment.

onlyWithContact.title: Only accounts with email, phone or website (needs enrichment)
onlyWithContact.description: For lead lists. Turns on enrichment.

resumeFromLastRun.title: Resume where the last run stopped
resumeFromLastRun.description: Big lists can be exported over several runs: each run continues exactly where the previous one stopped (limit, safety stop or timeout) — no repeats, no gaps.

skipPreviouslyScraped.title: Only accounts not exported before
skipPreviouslyScraped.description: Skip accounts already saved for this profile and list in earlier runs — e.g. schedule daily with "Resume" off to get only new followers.

stateStoreName.title: Memory store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store for resume points and exported IDs.

pageSize.title: Accounts per request
pageSize.description: Instagram's own app asks for 50. Lower is gentler, higher is faster.

minDelaySec.title: Min pause between requests (seconds)
minDelaySec.description: Random human-like pauses protect the account. Do not go below 2 for long runs.

maxDelaySec.title: Max pause between requests (seconds)
maxDelaySec.description: Upper end of the random pause.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (one sticky IP for the whole run)
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential, ideally in the country where you normally use this account (set the country). The run keeps one IP — it never rotates, because a logged-in session hopping IPs triggers Instagram checks.
